Importance: Provides high-resolution multispectral imagery suitable for coastal monitoring (Vos et al., 2019a)
Surface reflectance product ensures radiometric consistency (Tesfaye & Breuer, 2024)
Enables large-scale cloud processing and temporal analysis (Gorelick et al., 2017b)
Multi-year dataset enables detection of long-term shoreline trends
Minimizes snow/ice interference and ensures seasonal consistency
Removes clouds, shadows, and snow for accurate classification (Kita et al., 2023)
Reduces noise and improves inter-annual stability
B3 is sensitive to water reflectance; essential for NDWI calculation and B8 differentiates land from water due to strong water absorption  (McFeeters, 1996b)
Captures shoreline variability while maintaining regional coverage
Provides stable separation of land and water along coastlines
